'''[[Vorn Tel-Ovis|Vorn's]] junk shop''' was a junk shop in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Mos Shuuta/Legends|Mos Shuuta]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. A group of individuals on the run from the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Teemo/Legends|Teemo]] sought to obtain an [[hypermatter reactor igniter]] that Tel-Ovis promised for [[Trex]], in order to take the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter's]] [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|freighter]], ''[[Krayt Fang]]'', for themselves to get off-planet.
